payload.summary: A hardcoded topic denylist refuses in-corpus psychiatric queries with zero retrieval and caches the empty result
payload.detail: rag-query-guard.ts:6 short-circuits any query matching ssri, antibiotic, pneumonia, hyperkalaemia and others; every token was transcribed from the eval fixture questions. ssri is demonstrably in-corpus: the golden fixture case vector-gad-worry expects a Generalised Anxiety document whose expectedContentTerms include ssri. So 'Which SSRI is first line for generalised anxiety disorder?' is refused content-blind and the empty result is cached. Worse for eval integrity: classifyCorpusGrounding, the deterministic mechanism built to make exactly this call, is explicitly bypassed for these queries, so the unsupported-query controls pass by literal topic-word match on their own question text rather than by the grounding machinery they exist to validate. A second divergent copy of the same regex lives at clinical-search.ts:371 and additionally contains 'ketamine sedation', so the two guards already disagree. FIX: delete the denylist, let classifyCorpusGrounding decide, single source of truth. Protected surface: needs approval and a canary pair.
